title: プログラミング総合
subtitle: Comprehensive Programing
educationalGoal: In this course, students aim to solidify their C language programming skills and improve their programming thinking skills through exercises that comprehensively utilize the C language programming skills they have learned.
advice: This course aims to solidify the C language programming techniques learned so far. At the same time, students will also learn and deepen their understanding of applied grammar through lectures and exercises, such as structures, multi-dimensional arrays, and pointers. Students will also learn about numerical calculation problems such as differentiation and integration. The learning items are as follows. - Review of control structures and functions - Review of pointers and structures - Applications of arrays (multi-dimensional arrays, etc.) - Numerical calculations (differentiation, integration, etc.) Students will practice using the C language development environment on their PC to deepen their understanding.
books: Textbooks: Reference books: Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This class assumes that students have already taken "Introduction to Programming," "Programming I," and "Programming II." Students will practice using their PC and C language development environment. Students should thoroughly review the C language grammar and how to operate the development environment.

activityGoals.body: Be able to derive the optimal solution using C programming.
Be able to find and correct mistakes in the program.
Be able to create simple arithmetic programs.
Be able to create practical programs such as numerical calculations.
